
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; color: rgba(92, 97, 102, 1); background-color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; padding: 1.5em 1em"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在文档安全管理中，通过编程控制 PDF 的访问权限（如禁止打印、禁止复制等）是常见需求。本文使用 Free Spire.PDF for .NET 免费库，基于其 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfSecurityPolicy</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 类，介绍如何用简洁的 C# 代码完成权限设置。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">两种密码的角色</span></h2>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: disc">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">用户密码（User Password）</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：打开文档时输入的密码。若设为空字符串，则打开无需密码。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">所有者密码（Owner Password）</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：用于控制文档权限的“管理密码”。持有者密码可以设置或解除各项操作限制。</span></li>
</ul>
<blockquote style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; font-size: 0.95em; overflow: auto; border-left: 3px solid rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 12px 20px; margin: 1em 0; background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1)">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">用户密码决定“能否打开”，所有者密码决定“能做什么”。</span></p>
</blockquote>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">环境准备</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过 NuGet 安装免费版包：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">PM&gt; Install-Package FreeSpire.PDF
</code></pre>
<blockquote style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; font-size: 0.95em; overflow: auto; border-left: 3px solid rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 12px 20px; margin: 1em 0; background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1)">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">该免费版无功能水印，但有页数限制（前 10 页），适用于评估和小型项目。</span></p>
</blockquote>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">核心类：PdfSecurityPolicy</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">该免费 PDF 库使用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfSecurityPolicy</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 及其派生类 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfPasswordSecurityPolicy</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 来统一管理加密算法、密码和权限。此方式将各个关注点分离，代码更加清晰。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">基本步骤</span></h3>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">加载 PDF 文档</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">创建 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfPasswordSecurityPolicy</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，传入用户密码和所有者密码</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">设置加密算法（如 AES-256）</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">DocumentPrivilege</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性指定允许或禁止的操作</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">调用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">doc.Encrypt(securityPolicy)</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 应用策略</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">保存文档</span></li>
</ol>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">示例：禁止打印和复制，允许填写表单</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Pdf;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Pdf.Security;
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">namespace</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">PdfPermissionDemo</span><br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">class</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Program</span><br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-function" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">static</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">void</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Main</span>(<span class="hljs-params" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span>[] <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">args</span></span>)</span><br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 1. 加载 PDF</span><br>
PdfDocument doc = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> PdfDocument();<br>
doc.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"原始文档.pdf"</span>);</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 2. 创建密码安全策略</span><br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> userPwd = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">""</span>;                    <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 打开无需密码</span><br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> ownerPwd = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"owner@2026"</span>;         <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 权限密码</span><br>
PdfPasswordSecurityPolicy policy = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> PdfPasswordSecurityPolicy(<br>
userPwd, ownerPwd);</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 3. 使用 AES-256 加密（更安全）</span><br>
policy.EncryptionAlgorithm = PdfEncryptionAlgorithm.AES_256;</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 4. 设置权限</span><br>
policy.DocumentPrivilege.AllowPrint = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">false</span>;             <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 禁止打印</span><br>
policy.DocumentPrivilege.AllowContentCopying = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">false</span>;    <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 禁止复制</span><br>
policy.DocumentPrivilege.AllowModifyAnnotations = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">false</span>; <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 禁止修改注释</span><br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 允许填写表单（默认允许，如需禁用可设为 false）</span><br>
policy.DocumentPrivilege.AllowFillFormFields = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">true</span>;</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 5. 应用加密策略</span><br>
doc.Encrypt(policy);</p>
</code><p><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 6. 保存新文档</span><br>
doc.SaveToFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"受限文档.pdf"</span>);<br>
}<br>
}<br>
}<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">权限属性一览</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfDocumentPrivilege</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 类提供以下常用布尔属性，可单独设置：</span></p>
<figure class="figure-table" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; text-align: center; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch"><table style="box-sizing: border-box; display: table; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); font-weight: bold; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); text-align: center; min-width: 6em"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">说明</span></th></tr></thead><tbody style="box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AllowPrint</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; text-align: left"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AllowContentCopying</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">是否允许复制文本和图形</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AllowModifyAnnotations</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">是否允许添加或修改注释</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background-color: rgba(250, 250, 250, 1)"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AllowFillFormFields</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AllowModifyContents</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">是否允许修改文档内容（非注释）</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background-color: rgba(250, 250, 250, 1)"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AllowAssembly</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); text-align: left"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">是否允许插入/旋转/删除页面（仅 128 位及以上加密）</span></td></tr></tbody></table></figure>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通常做法是：</span></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: disc">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">若只允许少数操作，先 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">ForbidAll</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，再单独开启需要的项。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">若只禁止少数操作，先 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AllowAll</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，再关闭不需要的项。</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">示例：</span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">仅允许打印，其他全部禁止</strong></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">policy.DocumentPrivilege = PdfDocumentPrivilege.ForbidAll;
policy.DocumentPrivilege.AllowPrint = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">true</span>;
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.2em 0 0.5em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.2em; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">组合多个权限</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">所有权限属性可独立设置，互相不受影响。例如，允许高质量打印且允许复制内容，但禁止修改：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">policy.DocumentPrivilege = PdfDocumentPrivilege.AllowAll;
policy.DocumentPrivilege.AllowPrint = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">true</span>;
policy.DocumentPrivilege.AllowContentCopying = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">true</span>;
policy.DocumentPrivilege.AllowModifyContents = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">false</span>;
policy.DocumentPrivilege.AllowModifyAnnotations = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">false</span>;
</code></pre>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">补充：移除权限保护（解密）</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">若需解密已加密的 PDF，可使用所有者密码加载后调用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Decrypt()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">PdfDocument doc = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> PdfDocument();
doc.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"受限文档.pdf"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"owner@2026"</span>);  <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 传入所有者密码</span>
doc.Decrypt();
doc.SaveToFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"已解密.pdf"</span>);
</code></pre>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">注意事项</span></h2>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: disc">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">用户密码为空</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：打开文档无需密码，但权限限制依然生效（由所有者密码持有者控制）。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">加密算法</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AES_256</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 安全性最高，但旧版 PDF 阅读器可能不支持；如需兼容性，可使用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AES_128</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">免费版限制</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：Free Spire.PDF 对文档页数有限制（通常为 10 页），超出部分可能无法处理。评估时可使用小型文件测试。</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">总结</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">PdfSecurityPolicy</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，开发者可以以面向对象的方式清晰管理 PDF 的加密和权限。只需几行代码，即可灵活控制打印、复制、修改等操作，满足企业文档安全需求。这种方案代码可读性强，易于维护，是处理 PDF 权限控制的推荐实践。</span></p></section>

</div>
